scientific_integrity: Reconstructed symbolic proof and finite exhaustive arithmetic checks; prior unmarked partition results are credited; independently audited: no.
scientific_limitations: The model uses independent uniform Bell partitions, labelled worlds, and independent fair valuations; it does not address nonuniform/correlated frame laws, valuation constraints, history-dependent distributed knowledge, or modal formulas other than the displayed implication. The Lambert-W asymptotic is fixed-agent-count only; the Bell-ratio bound is uniform. The unmarked meet and quotient counts belong to Pittel and Canfield. Historical priority of the marked polynomial or relative-error law has not been independently certified.
title: Exact modal-failure polynomial and uniform rare-defect law for distributed knowledge
